text: At its meeting on March 6, 2026, the Board of Directors, CreateTO considered Item RA24.4 and referred it back to the CreateTO - Human Resources Committee for further consideration.

The CreateTO - Human Resources Committee recommends that: 1. The Board of Directors, CreateTO approve the confidential recommendation from the CreateTO Human Resources Committee, attached to motion 1a by Chair Allison Mendes. 2. The Board of Directors, CreateTO direct that the confidential recommendation, attached to motion 1a by Chair Allison Mendes, from the CreateTO Human Resources Committee remain confidential in its entirety as it relates to personal information of an identifiable individual, including a municipal or local board employee. 3. The Board of Directors, CreateTO direct that the confidential recommendation (February 20, 2026) from the CreateTO Human Resources Committee and the confidential information (March 6, 2026) presented by the Vice President, People and Culture in closed session, attached to the letter (March 6, 2026) from the Board of Directors, CreateTO on 2025…
